title.narrative: Upgrading of Muyembe Nakapiripirit Road Project

description.narrative:
The overarching development objective is to facilitate socio-economic development by upgrading the earthen/gravel road links to (a) improve safety, (b) meet the present and future transportation demands and (c) enhance the overall efficiency of road transportation system.
The objective of the project is to upgrade 92km existing earthen/gravel road between Muyembe and Nakapiripirit towns to asphaltic paved road standard and improve 25km secondary road links.
